systemErrors.title: Errors
systemErrors.subtitle: Everything the platform could not do, and when.
systemErrors.allClearBody: No server errors, no document that failed to be read, no scheduled job that did not finish.
systemErrors.documents: {count, plural, =1 {One document could not be read} other {# documents could not be read}}
systemErrors.documentsHelp: These were uploaded but never indexed, so the assistant cannot answer from them. Usually the file itself is the problem — a scan with no text, or a file saved in an old format. Try again first; if it fails twice, ask for the file to be re-saved.
systemErrors.retryQueued: Queued — it will be read again within a minute.
systemErrors.retryFailed: Could not queue it. Try again in a moment.
systemErrors.server: {count, plural, =1 {One server error} other {# server errors}}
systemErrors.serverHelp: A request that failed outright. Whoever made it saw an error message. Open one for the full trace — that is what a developer needs.
systemErrors.jobs: {count, plural, =1 {One scheduled job failed} other {# scheduled jobs failed}}
systemErrors.jobsHelp: Usually the weekly digest, which means those emails did not go out. It runs again on its next schedule.
